goal: Retrieval only approved claims in backend/services/history_tutor.py and backend/history_models.py

features_delivered: Strict approved claims retrieval gate: retrieve_verified_claims enforces approved verification statuses (expert_verified, published, editor_reviewed, verified) and strictly excludes all draft (draft, internal_review), unreviewed (unreviewed, needs_source, source_attached), and disputed (disputed, rejected, superseded, archived) claims
Model invariants on HistoricalClaim: added is_approved, is_published, is_draft, is_unreviewed, and is_disputed property helpers; added is_approved property on HistoricalSource

Source verification enforcement: retrieve_sources retrieves strictly approved sources (metadata_verified, accessible) with eligible bindings (supports, primary_evidence_for) and filters out unreviewed, draft, or rejected sources
Contradiction blocking: _has_contradicting_source blocks any claim with active 'contradicts' bindings from being retrieved or treated as approved authority

Negative abuse defense: Asking about a draft-only, unreviewed-only, or disputed fact returns explicit abstention ('Không đủ sử liệu xác thực' / abstention) with confidence='low', citations=[], and zero draft fact or hallucinated leakage

test_details.name: test_retrieve_verified_claims_strictly_returns_approved_tiers
test_details.assertion: Verifies that retrieve_verified_claims retrieves expert_verified, published, editor_reviewed, and verified claims while blocking draft, internal_review, unreviewed, disputed, and rejected claims.

test_details.name: test_zero_draft_claim_leakage
test_details.assertion: Verifies that draft and internal_review claims are never returned, even when include_unverified is explicitly True.

test_details.name: test_zero_disputed_or_contested_claim_leakage
test_details.assertion: Verifies that claims with status disputed, confidence disputed/contested, or claim_type disputed are strictly blocked from retrieval.

test_details.name: test_contradicted_claims_strictly_excluded
test_details.assertion: Verifies that claims having source bindings with support_type='contradicts' are strictly excluded from approved claims.

test_details.name: test_source_approval_gates_in_retrieve_sources
test_details.assertion: Verifies that retrieve_sources retrieves metadata_verified sources and drops unreviewed and rejected sources.

test_details.name: test_historical_claim_and_source_model_invariants
test_details.assertion: Verifies HistoricalClaim.is_approved, is_published, is_draft, is_unreviewed, is_disputed and HistoricalSource.is_approved model properties.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_draft_only_fact_returns_explicit_abstention
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse test: Asking about a draft-only fact returns explicit abstention ('Không đủ sử liệu xác thực'), confidence='low', citations=[], and zero draft fact leakage.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_unreviewed_fact_returns_explicit_abstention
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse test: Asking about an unreviewed fact without flag returns explicit abstention with zero leaked unreviewed claims.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_disputed_fact_returns_explicit_abstention
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse test: Asking about a disputed fact returns explicit abstention and zero citation leakage.

test_details.name: test_end_to_end_verified_vs_draft_segregation
test_details.assertion: End-to-end segregation test: verified claim query succeeds with citations and high confidence, while draft-only query abstains with zero draft leakage on the same entity.
